operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm run verify && pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && pnpm check:deployment-spec
operations.recovery: Follow OPERATIONS.md and docs/BACKUP-RESTORE.md: stop writes and scheduled work, retain the exact source and a private archive, restore with rer import into an empty installation, establish the receiving owner and mail settings, re-export and compare job records and photo bytes before routing traffic. Preserve every applied migration name and byte.
